Search Filter

Search Filter combines a search input with filter chips, category filters, date ranges, and sort options. Active filters are shown as removable chips with a count badge.

Search with Filter Chips

Active filters display as removable chips below the search bar.

Demo JavaScript

JavaScript
// Chips search filter
(function () {
  var input = document.getElementById('sf-chips-input');
  var catSelect = document.getElementById('sf-chips-category');
  var chipsContainer = document.getElementById('sf-chips-active');
  var rows = document.querySelectorAll('#sf-chips-table tbody tr');
  var activeFilters = { search: '', category: '' };

  function renderChips() {
    chipsContainer.innerHTML = '';
    if (activeFilters.search) addChip('Search: ' + activeFilters.search, 'search');
    if (activeFilters.category) addChip('Category: ' + activeFilters.category, 'category');
  }

  function addChip(label, key) {
    var chip = document.createElement('span');
    chip.className = 'zak-badge';
    chip.style.cssText = 'display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;cursor:pointer;';
    chip.innerHTML = label + ' <button style="background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:0;font-size:1rem;line-height:1;color:var(--zak-text-muted);">&times;</button>';
    chip.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', function () {
      activeFilters[key] = '';
      if (key === 'search') input.value = '';
      if (key === 'category') catSelect.value = '';
      applySF();
    });
    chipsContainer.appendChild(chip);
  }

  function applySF() {
    rows.forEach(function (row) {
      var matchSearch = !activeFilters.search || row.textContent.toLowerCase().indexOf(activeFilters.search) !== -1;
      var matchCat = !activeFilters.category || row.dataset.category === activeFilters.category;
      row.style.display = matchSearch && matchCat ? '' : 'none';
    });
    renderChips();
  }

  input.addEventListener('input', function () { activeFilters.search = input.value.toLowerCase(); applySF(); });
  catSelect.addEventListener('change', function () { activeFilters.category = catSelect.value; applySF(); });
})();

// Category filter buttons
(function () {
  var buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.sf-cat-btn');
  var cards = document.querySelectorAll('#sf-category-grid .zak-card');
  var chipsContainer = document.getElementById('sf-category-chips');
  var currentCat = 'all';

  buttons.forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      buttons.forEach(function (b) { b.className = 'zak-btn zak-btn-sm zak-btn-outline sf-cat-btn'; });
      btn.className = 'zak-btn zak-btn-sm zak-btn-primary sf-cat-btn';
      currentCat = btn.dataset.cat;
      cards.forEach(function (card) {
        card.style.display = (currentCat === 'all' || card.dataset.cat === currentCat) ? '' : 'none';
      });
      chipsContainer.innerHTML = '';
      if (currentCat !== 'all') {
        var chip = document.createElement('span');
        chip.className = 'zak-badge';
        chip.style.cssText = 'display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;cursor:pointer;';
        chip.innerHTML = currentCat + ' <button style="background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:1rem;line-height:1;color:var(--zak-text-muted);">&times;</button>';
        chip.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', function () { buttons[0].click(); });
        chipsContainer.appendChild(chip);
      }
    });
  });
})();

// Date range & sort filter
(function () {
  var fromInput = document.getElementById('sf-date-from');
  var toInput = document.getElementById('sf-date-to');
  var sortSelect = document.getElementById('sf-sort');
  var chipsContainer = document.getElementById('sf-datesort-chips');
  var countBadge = document.getElementById('sf-filter-count');
  var clearBtn = document.getElementById('sf-clear-all');
  var result = document.getElementById('sf-datesort-result');

  function updateSF() {
    var count = 0;
    chipsContainer.innerHTML = '';
    if (fromInput.value) { addSFChip('From: ' + fromInput.value); count++; }
    if (toInput.value) { addSFChip('To: ' + toInput.value); count++; }
    if (sortSelect.value) { addSFChip('Sort: ' + sortSelect.options[sortSelect.selectedIndex].text); count++; }
    countBadge.textContent = count;
    countBadge.style.display = count ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
    clearBtn.style.display = count ? '' : 'none';
    result.textContent = count ? count + ' filter(s) active — results filtered.' : 'Results will appear here when filters are applied.';
  }

  function addSFChip(label) {
    var chip = document.createElement('span');
    chip.className = 'zak-badge';
    chip.style.cssText = 'display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;cursor:pointer;';
    chip.innerHTML = label + ' <button style="background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:1rem;line-height:1;color:var(--zak-text-muted);">&times;</button>';
    chip.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', function () {
      if (label.startsWith('From')) fromInput.value = '';
      if (label.startsWith('To')) toInput.value = '';
      if (label.startsWith('Sort')) sortSelect.value = '';
      updateSF();
    });
    chipsContainer.appendChild(chip);
  }

  fromInput.addEventListener('change', updateSF);
  toInput.addEventListener('change', updateSF);
  sortSelect.addEventListener('change', updateSF);
  window.clearAllSF = function () { fromInput.value = ''; toInput.value = ''; sortSelect.value = ''; updateSF(); };
})();
